entries.description: A query a module builds before it runs (ПостроительЗапроса). Text is the query text. Parameters is a Structure; Execute copies each name into the query and runs it, and answers with a QueryResult. GetQuery returns that query without running it. FillSettings is accepted and does not build a filter or an order: those settings are not a type here.
entries.parameters: text — the query text. Left out, the builder is empty.
